flags.description: Chapter 1: Welcome to the Clouds is complete.
The player noticed a mysterious, unmarked workshop symbol.
Chapter 3: The Missing Collection is complete.
Chef Blaze’s Kitchen milestone opened after Level 20.
The Higher Art Gallery preview appeared after Level 30.
The Collector found a trail leading toward the gallery.

chapters.title: Welcome to the Clouds
chapters.synopsis: Meet Mr. Weed, explore the Cloud House, and begin restoring the Kingdom.

lines.text: Well, look who made it through the clouds. I'm Mr. Weed, and this is the Cloud House.
It has seen sunnier days. The rooms are quiet, the shelves are bare, and the old Kingdom could use a little care.
Every puzzle you solve sends a little energy back through the clouds. Piece by piece, we can restore the house and the Kingdom around it.
Let's take a look around. There's plenty of room for new stories, new finds, and a brighter morning.

chapters.title: Kitchen Catastrophe
chapters.synopsis: Chef Blaze needs help getting the Cloud House kitchen ready. New story beats appear as you clear the chapter.

lines.text: Welcome to my cloud kitchen! The pantry shelves are rattling and the counter is buried in puzzle crates.
Every clear makes a little more room. Let’s get this kitchen ready for the Kingdom.
The prep table is finally visible. The recipe cards are fantasy riddles, so we’ll solve them with matches and a pinch of imagination.
Five more levels should bring the whole room back to life.
That did it! The Kitchen is open, and the Cloud House smells like warm cinnamon rolls from a storybook.
A new room, a new chapter, and no mystery left on the pantry shelves. Nice work.

chapters.title: The Missing Collection
chapters.synopsis: The Collector follows a trail of scattered keepsakes through the Kingdom. New story beats unlock as the pieces come together.

lines.text: Several cards and display labels have vanished from my archive. I found a trail of tiny gold flecks leading away from the shelves.
Let’s follow the clues one puzzle at a time.
These pieces belong together, but someone left the frame empty. The marks point toward a room we can’t enter yet.
A trail is a start. We’ll keep the strange little workshop mark in mind, too.
The missing pieces are back in the archive. They form a map to a gallery wing hidden behind the high clouds.
There it is! The Higher Art Gallery is only a glimpse for now. We have another mystery to solve before its doors open.
